component.name: Murmur
component.summary: Shape your microphone for games and voice chat

description.p: Murmur is a real-time microphone processor for Linux. Choose a microphone, shape your voice with clearly labelled controls, and select Murmur Virtual Microphone in your game or voice-chat application.

Adjust tone, pitch, digital texture and dynamics. Save voice presets, compare the original signal with effects bypassed, and preview changes through headphones. With desktop background access granted, the audio service continues after you close the window. If access is denied, keep the window open. Processing can be stopped explicitly from the application.
Murmur uses PipeWire and supports both Wayland and X11 desktops. It processes audio locally without a cloud account.
Organised voice controls, additional dynamics and creative effects, and preparation for portable desktop packaging.
